17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 1313 South Talman Avenue, Chicago, IL
Proposed Zoning: RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: 2,660 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to develop the subject property with a new
three-story residential building containing three (3) dwelling units. The
proposed building will measure 34 fi.-10 inches in height. The subject
property is a Transit Served Location and will be supported by two (2) off-
street parking spaces at the rear. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional
Administrative Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to Secs. 17-13-1101
of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking optional
Variation approval to reduce the rear setback to 38.42 ft. reduce the
combined side setback to 1 ft., and any other relief necessary, as allowed by
the Code, for the Type 1 Plan Set.

(A) The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 4,251 square feet (1.60 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 886.67 square feet per D.U.
(3 residential units)

(C) The amount of off-street parking: 2 parking spaces

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location (Roosevelt Bus
Route).

(D) Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: 15 feet
b. Side Setbacks:
South Side: 6 inches
North Side: 6 inches
c. *Rear Setback: 38.42 feet

*Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1101-B, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the rear setback
to 38.42 ft.

(E) Building Height: 34 ft.-10 inches
